description: This source file defines the AdminServerContainer class in the OFBiz framework. It provides functionality for setting up and managing an admin socket server that listens for commands such as status inquiries and shutdown requests from clients, enabling remote administration of a running OFBiz instance.

classes.name: AdminServerContainer
classes.description: A final class implementing Container, responsible for initializing, starting, and stopping an admin socket server that manages remote commands for OFBiz administration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the admin server with commands, name, and configuration file, setting up the server socket and control thread.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server thread to listen for incoming admin connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Interrupts the server thread to cease listening for connections.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this server instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop of the server thread that accepts client connections and processes their requests.

methods.name: processClientRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming client requests, parses commands, responds with server status or acknowledgment, and initiates system shutdown if commanded.

methods.name: determineClientCommand
methods.description: Interprets a request string from the client to an internal command enum if valid.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Checks if a given request string conforms to expected format and authorization key.

methods.name: prepareResponseToClient
methods.description: Generates a response string based on the server's current state and the client's command.
